claims: Banana Ball was created by the Savannah Bananas.
In Banana Ball, games have a two-hour time limit.
In Banana Ball, bunting is not allowed.
In Banana Ball, if a fan catches a foul ball, the batter is out.
In Banana Ball, every inning is worth a point.
In Banana Ball, if the game is tied, it is decided by a one-on-one competition between a hitter and a pitcher.
In Banana Ball, batters can attempt to steal first base during a pitch.
The Savannah Bananas are owned by Fans First Entertainment.
The Savannah Bananas play against opponents like the Party Animals.
The Savannah Bananas have a larger social media footprint than many MLB teams.
The Savannah Bananas play a nationwide tour.
Fans must join a ticket lottery to attend Banana Ball games.
The 2026 Banana Ball tour includes games at First Horizon Park.
The 2026 Banana Ball tour includes games at the Caesars Superdome.
Banana Ball players are professional athletes.
Many Banana Ball players earn roughly $100,000 annually.
Roughly $100,000 annually is significantly more than what most minor league players earn.
Banana Ball is often called the “Harlem Globetrotters of baseball.”
